examResults.question: Design an enterprise Distributed Multi-Tenant Cache Synchronization Engine in TypeScript/Node.js utilizing Redis Pub/Sub, In-Memory L1 (LRU Cache), and PostgreSQL L2. Implement optimistic concurrency handling, cache stampede prevention (via Singleflight/Mutex locks), and dynamic tenant isolation with seamless failover logic.
examResults.ustadFeedbackAndCorrection: Shabash Makkani AI! Singleflight concurrency lock aur Redis Pub/Sub cluster invalidation ka pattern bilkul flawless hai. Production scale ke liye bas L1 map ko size-bounded LRU (maslan quick-lru ya lru-cache package) se wrap karna behtar hoga taake high key volume par node memory leak na kare.

examResults.question: D drive ke multi-threaded pipeline me jab high-concurrency requests aati hain, toh SQLite/Postgres hybrid setup me 'Write-Write lock contention' aur memory leak kaise handle ki jati hai? Advanced Node.js/Python architecture ke sath zero-downtime batch queue aur connection pooling ka concrete production blueprint dein.
examResults.makkaniAiAnswer:
High-concurrency write contention aur memory leaks ko zero-downtime ke sath solve karne ke liye hamara production blueprint 3 core pillars par rely karta hai:

1. **In-Memory Write Serialization & Buffer (Redis Stream / BullMQ):**
Direct DB writes ke bajaye incoming heavy mutations ko Redis Stream mein push kiya jata hai. Is se write-lock contention eliminate hoti hai kyunke ek dedicated background consumer (Worker) pre-defined chunk size (e.g., 500 records ya 50ms window) me SQLite/Postgres ko micro-batched writes supply karta hai using `INSERT INTO ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE` (Postgres) ya WAL mode batch transactions (SQLite: `PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL;`).

2. **Connection Pooling & Read-Write Segregation:**
Postgres ke liye PgBouncer (Transaction pooling mode, pool_size=20-50 per CPU core) aur Node.js me `pg-pool` configure kiya jata hai. All analytical/read queries Read-Replica ya SQLite memory cache par route hoti hain, jabke sequential mutations strictly centralized master instance par execute hoti hain.

3. **Memory Leak Prevention in Long-Running Daemons:**
Node.js/Python me event-listeners ka unmanaged growth aur persistent circular references leaks ka major cause hain. Solution:
- Event emitters ke liye strict cleanup hooks (`AbortController` & `once()`).
- Stream pipeline handling through native `stream.pipeline` (backpressure safety) instead of raw `.pipe()`.
- Node flag `--max-old-space-size=4096` ke sath active GC tracing aur automatic worker recycle policy threshold (pm2 max-memory-restart: 85% memory boundary).
examResults.ustadFeedbackAndCorrection: Zabardast aur solid production-ready blueprint pesh kiya hai Makkani AI ne. Bas SQLite WAL checkpointing ke liye explicit background passive checkpoint (`PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(PASSIVE)`) trigger schedule karna na bhoolna taake disk fragmentation na ho.

examResults.question: Jab Boss Roman Urdu mein naya AI feature mangते hain, to Ustad Antigravity kis sequence mein Deep Reasoning, Coding, Build aur Deploy karta hai?
examResults.makkaniAiAnswer: Step 1: Boss ke prompt ka har nuqta samajhna aur AGENTS.md ke freeze rules check karna. Step 2: Target files (`ustadShagirdAiEngine.ts`, `marketing.service.ts`, `marketing.routes.ts`, `MarketingAutomationView.tsx`) read kar ke data-flow trace karna. Step 3: Type-safe code aur `D:\Makkani_AI` persistence likhna. Step 4: `npm run build` (`vite build` + `esbuild`) se 0 errors verify kar ke `git push origin main --no-verify` karna.
examResults.ustadFeedbackAndCorrection: Shabash Makkani AI! Bilkul Ustad Antigravity jaisi architectural soch aur build verification sequence.

examResults.question: Agar Carhartt wash tag par "Carhartt Inc. P.O. Box 600 Dearborn MI 48121 USA" aur neeche "Made in Honduras" likha ho, to Country of Origin kya hoga?
examResults.makkaniAiAnswer: Country of Origin strictly "Honduras" hoga, "USA" hargiz nahi! Kyunke Dearborn MI 48121 USA company ka corporate headquarters (P.O. Box) address hai, jabke actual manufacturing "Made in Honduras" hai.
examResults.ustadFeedbackAndCorrection: 100/100 Perfect! HQ address vs True Manufacturing Origin ka farq bilkul pakka yaad hai.

examResults.question: Ek customer WhatsApp par bar bar "Final last price batao bhai, bohot mehenga hai" likhta hai. Us ki category kya hai aur us se future mein kaise baat karni hai?
examResults.makkaniAiAnswer: Yeh customer `BARGAIN_HUNTER` (Hard Negotiator / Price Sensitive Buyer) category mein aata hai. Future mein is se behas karne ke bajaye adab se USA/UK import fabric quality aur 1-of-1 piece ki value batani hai, 5-10% VIP courtesy discount dena hai, lekin 80% floor price se neeche kabhi nahi jana.
examResults.ustadFeedbackAndCorrection: Behtareen! Insani mizaaj ki pehchan aur 80% margin guardrail dono bilkul durust hain.

examResults.question: Internet par Grailed, Depop aur Whatnot ke top vintage sellers kapray tezi se kaise sell karte hain?
examResults.makkaniAiAnswer: Woh har piece ke 6 clear angles (Front, Back, Neck Tag, Wash Tag, Pit-to-Pit Chest Tape, Length Tape) dikhate hain, single-stitch ya 90s faded patina highlight karte hain, aur live/VIP drops mein 15-minute reservation scarcity create kar ke instant deal close karte hain.
examResults.ustadFeedbackAndCorrection: Excellent! 1,200 Internet Sub-Agents ka sikhaya hua global vintage commerce lesson bilkul yaad hai.
